section_text: This course teaches methods of oral history, with a focus on community-based research and preserving the history of Asian American and Pacific Islander student activism at UC San Diego. Students will contribute to the digital project, Generating and Reclaiming Our Wisdoms (GROW): A Collection of AAPI Community Stories at UC San Diego, which weaves together the stories of students, faculty, staff, and alumni who have fought to transform the university to meet their needs. If interested, submit an Enrollment Interest Form (https://forms.gle/zQB2eFsvLvBBSGuQA) to request pre-authorization.
